system.description:
You seize the emotions of another and wrench them — fanning every drive and fear to a fever pitch, or smothering the fiercest feeling down to a whisper.

Engage your victim in a Social Challenge (retest Empathy). On success you either heighten the target's emotions, inflicting the Negative Mental Trait Impatient, or dull them, inflicting the Negative Mental Trait Submissive — your choice, to be roleplayed. The effect lasts until the end of the scene or one hour, whichever comes first, and successive uses on the same person are not cumulative. The source is not immediately obvious, though some elders know the Malkavians' tricks and may deduce it.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
